description.value:
Your grasp of history serves you well. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Lore skill, or expertise in it if you're already proficient. When you use the Help action to assist another creature's ability check, you can make a DC 15 Intelligence (Lore) check; on a success, the creature you're helping — provided it can understand you — gains a bonus to its check equal to your proficiency bonus, drawn from the relevant history and precedent you recall.
